HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

3. Which statement about Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.

4. Which statement about National Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain National Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say National Security never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing National Security.
   D. Treat National Security as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya.
   D. Say Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Colonial Administration in Africa.

   A. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.

   C. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.
   D. Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nakuru
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nairobi

9. Which statement about Political developments in independent Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Political developments in independent Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Political developments in independent Africa as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Political developments in independent Africa.
   D. Explain Political developments in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   C. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   A. Treat Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century as rumours only.

   D. Skip evidence when discussing Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century.

12. Which statement about Civilisations in South and Central Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Civilisations in South and Central Africa.

   C. Explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

15. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

16. Which statement about French Revolutions is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing French Revolutions.
   B. Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say French Revolutions never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat French Revolutions as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain French Revolutions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Aligned and Non-Aligned Movements from 1970 to 2020 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
